description: Which repository is this solution? Read-only; never returns a credential. Returns the repository id, owner, repo, web and clone URLs, default branch, production_branch (`main`) and development_branch (`dev`), and a status: linked, provisioning, disconnected or error, with a `reason`. No repository means `disconnected` (the solution lives only on the platform). `visibility` and `permissions` are not recorded yet: expect `unknown` and null. Can you run Git? Clone `clone_url`, push to `dev`, deploy the commit with ateam_build_and_run(ref). If not, or the clone is refused, use the ateam_github_* tools.
name: ateam_get_repository_binding
